This working report audits the current input files and, when explicitly selected,
reads a completed projection attempt. Rendering **never compiles or runs ADMB**.
Conditional projections describe the supplied inputs and assumptions; they are
not adopted catch recommendations.

## Run controls

From this directory, render the current audit and included saved results with:

```bash
quarto render greenland_turbot.qmd
```

To include results, set `saved_run` in the YAML above or pass the actual attempt
directory explicitly. This example path is illustrative; the report never selects
the newest directory automatically:

```bash
quarto render greenland_turbot.qmd -P saved_run:spmR_runs/attempt-001
```

```{r}
#| label: report_controls
#| code-fold: false
saved_run <- params$saved_run
worms_per_plot <- 15L
table_years <- 3L
```

### Start a new projection manually

Run this chunk yourself in R **after reviewing the input audit**. It is excluded
from rendering. Keep `run_new_projections = FALSE` until the histories are complete.
Supply verified population weights, units and ages, or explicitly choose the
diagnostic assumptions with `use_diagnostic_weights = TRUE`. Diagnostic mode
cannot repair missing history values. Work from `examples/gt_2026` in R.

```{r}
#| label: manual_projection
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
source("run.R")
run_new_projections <- FALSE
use_diagnostic_weights <- FALSE
population_weights <- NULL
units <- NULL
ages <- NULL

if (run_new_projections) {
  projection <- run_gt2026_projection(
    diagnostic = use_diagnostic_weights,
    population_weights = population_weights,
    units = units,
    ages = ages
  )
  projection$run_dir
}
```

After a successful run, use the returned directory as `saved_run` and render again.
Each new run receives a separate attempt directory. Re-rendering reads saved
outputs and preserves the attempt contents.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
required_packages <- c("spmR", "gt", "ggplot2", "ggthemes", "dplyr", "tidyr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop("Install required packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}
if (utils::packageVersion("spmR") < "0.4.3") {
  stop("Install spmR 0.4.3 or later and restart R.")
}
example_candidates <- c(".", file.path("examples", "gt_2026"))
example_dir <- example_candidates[
  file.exists(file.path(example_candidates, "ForProjections.dat")) &
    file.exists(file.path(example_candidates, "report.R"))
][1]
if (is.na(example_dir)) stop("Render from the source checkout or example directory.")
example_dir <- normalizePath(example_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(example_dir, "run.R"), local = TRUE)
source(file.path(example_dir, "report.R"), local = TRUE)
audit <- check_gt2026_inputs(example_dir)
raw_inputs <- gt2026_read_source(example_dir)
current_control <- spmR::dat2list(file.path(example_dir, "spm.dat"))
if (!is.character(saved_run) || length(saved_run) != 1L || is.na(saved_run)) {
  stop("saved_run must be one directory name, or an empty string for audit only.")
}
saved <- NULL
series <- NULL
if (nzchar(saved_run)) {
  selected_path <- if (grepl("^(~|/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", saved_run)) {
    path.expand(saved_run)
  } else {
    file.path(example_dir, saved_run)
  }
  saved <- gt2026_read_report_run(selected_path, example_dir)
  series <- gt2026_report_series(saved$result, n_worms = worms_per_plot)
}
```

## Current status

```{r}
#| label: current_status
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(saved)) {
  cat("**Audit only: no saved attempt selected.** No new projection was run.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("**Saved conditional projection loaded.** No new projection was run.\n\n")
  if (!all(saved$source_comparison$matches_current)) {
    cat("**Different source inputs:** these saved results belong to an earlier or different input revision, not the current files.\n\n")
  }
}
if (length(raw_inputs$recruitment) != length(raw_inputs$ssb)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "**New runs blocked:** the current file contains %d recruitment values and %d SSB values. Supply matching histories and confirm their calendar alignment; values are never padded or discarded.\n\n",
    length(raw_inputs$recruitment), length(raw_inputs$ssb)
  ))
} else {
  cat("Current recruitment and SSB lengths agree. Their calendar pairing and scientific declarations still require review.\n\n")
}
```

Diagnostic population weights are fleet-weighted catch-weight proxies, not
verified population body weights. SS3 export definitions, units, age order,
plus group, initial abundance timing and spawning-weight/maturity definitions
remain scientific review items. The audit below refers to **current files**;
saved-run assumptions are displayed separately in the provenance section.

## Input audit

The current controls request `r current_control$nsims` simulations across
`r current_control$nalts` alternatives for `r current_control$nprj_yrs` years,
beginning in `r current_control$beg_yr`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-input-audit
#| tbl-cap: "Current GT2026 input checks. Repair and review entries remain visible even when a saved run is selected."
#| echo: false
audit |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(item = "Input", status = "Status", detail = "Finding") |>
  gt::cols_width(item ~ gt::pct(18), status ~ gt::pct(12), detail ~ gt::pct(70))
```

## Projection plots

Each panel represents one alternative. The **same 15 simulations**, selected
deterministically by their sorted simulation IDs, appear as thin blue lines
("worms") in every plot. The black line is the median across **all** simulations;
the grey band spans their 5th–95th percentiles, a **90% projection interval**.
The 15 paths illustrate simulations rather than estimating the full uncertainty
by themselves. Fixed catches can cause several paths to overlap exactly.

```{r}
#| label: plot_setup
#| echo: false
if (is.null(series)) {
  cat("Plots will appear after selecting a verified completed attempt with at least 15 simulations. No placeholder projection data are plotted.")
} else {
  cat("Simulation IDs shown:", paste(series$worm_ids, collapse = ", "))
}
projection_plot <- function(metric_name, axis_label) {
  summary_data <- dplyr::filter(series$summary, .data$metric == metric_name)
  worm_data <- dplyr::filter(series$worms, .data$metric == metric_name)
  ggplot2::ggplot(summary_data, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$Year)) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = .data$lower, ymax = .data$upper),
      fill = "grey85"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = worm_data,
      ggplot2::aes(y = .data$value, group = .data$Sim),
      colour = "#336A99", alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes(y = .data$median), linewidth = 0.65) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(ggplot2::vars(Alt), ncol = 2, labeller = "label_both") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Projection year",
      y = paste0(axis_label, " (", saved$biomass_units, ")")
    ) +
    ggthemes::theme_few(base_size = 11)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ssb-worms
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-cap: "Conditional spawning biomass: 15 simulation paths per alternative, all-simulation median and 90% projection interval."
#| fig-alt: "Faceted spawning-biomass trajectories with one panel per alternative. Thin lines show fifteen selected simulations, a black line the median, and a grey band the projection interval. Numerical summaries follow the plots."
if (!is.null(series)) projection_plot("SSB", "Spawning biomass")
```

#| label: fig-biomass-worms

#| fig-cap: "Conditional total population biomass under the saved run's population-weight declarations."
#| fig-alt: "Faceted total-biomass trajectories by alternative, with fifteen simulation paths, the all-simulation median and the 90 percent projection interval."
if (!is.null(series)) projection_plot("Tot_biom", "Total biomass")
```

#| label: fig-catch-worms
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-cap: "Conditional catch trajectories. Prescribed catches can make the 15 simulation paths overlap."
#| fig-alt: "Faceted catch trajectories by alternative. Fifteen selected paths overlap where catches are prescribed; the median and projection interval use every simulation."
if (!is.null(series)) projection_plot("Catch", "Catch")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-abc-worms
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-cap: "Conditional model ABC trajectories; these calculations are not adopted catch recommendations."
#| fig-alt: "Faceted conditional ABC trajectories by alternative with fifteen simulation paths, the median and the 90 percent projection interval."
if (!is.null(series)) projection_plot("ABC", "ABC")
```

## Summary tables

Tables use all simulations, not only the 15 displayed paths. They are recomputed
from the hash-verified detailed output rather than an independently edited
summary file. The first table covers the first `r table_years` projection years;
the second reports terminal-year distributions.

```{r}
#| label: annual_means_table
#| echo: false
if (is.null(series)) {
  cat("No projection tables are available until a completed attempt is selected.")
} else {
  annual_means <- series$summary |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("Alt", "Year", "metric", "mean"))) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "metric", values_from = "mean")
  annual_means |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$Year < min(.data$Year) + table_years) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Alt = paste("Alternative", .data$Alt)) |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("annual_", .x)) |>
    gt::gt(groupname_col = "annual_Alt") |>
    gt::tab_caption("Conditional annual means by alternative for the first projection years. Units follow the saved run.") |>
    gt::tab_header(title = paste("Conditional annual means —", saved$biomass_units)) |>
    gt::cols_label(annual_Year = "Year", annual_Tot_biom = "Total biomass", annual_SSB = "Spawning biomass", annual_Catch = "Catch", annual_ABC = "ABC", annual_OFL = "OFL") |>
    gt::fmt_number(columns = paste0("annual_", c("SSB", "Tot_biom", "Catch", "ABC", "OFL")), decimals = 1)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: terminal_distribution_table
#| echo: false
if (!is.null(series)) {
  series$summary |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$Year == max(.data$Year)) |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("metric", "Alt", "Year", "median", "lower", "upper"))) |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("terminal_", .x)) |>
    gt::gt(groupname_col = "terminal_metric") |>
    gt::tab_caption("Terminal-year median and 5th–95th percentile projection range, using all simulations.") |>
    gt::tab_header(title = paste("Terminal projection distributions —", saved$biomass_units)) |>
    gt::cols_label(terminal_Alt = "Alternative", terminal_Year = "Year", terminal_median = "Median", terminal_lower = "5th percentile", terminal_upper = "95th percentile") |>
    gt::fmt_number(columns = c("terminal_median", "terminal_lower", "terminal_upper"), decimals = 1)
}
```

## Provenance and checks

The report requires a successful native exit and verifies recorded input,
output and archived-source hashes before displaying a saved run. It checks
result dimensions, alternative/year/simulation keys and finite nonnegative
quantities. Current-source differences are labelled rather than overwritten.
Historical-recruitment simulation fits no parameters: maximum-gradient and
positive-definite-Hessian diagnostics are **not applicable** in this mode.

```{r}
#| label: saved_provenance
#| echo: false
if (!is.null(saved)) {
  tibble::tibble(
    provenance_field = c("Selected directory", "Run ID", "Completed UTC", "spmR version at execution", "Executable SHA-256", "Population weights", "Scientific status"),
    recorded_value = c(
      saved_run, saved$provenance$run_id, saved$provenance$completed_utc,
      saved$provenance$package_version, saved$provenance$executable_sha256,
      saved$decisions$population_weights, saved$decisions$status
    )
  ) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::cols_label(provenance_field = "Provenance", recorded_value = "Recorded value") |>
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::px(13))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: source_comparison
#| echo: false
if (!is.null(saved)) {
  saved$source_comparison |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::cols_label(file = "Archived source", matches_current = "Matches current source")
}
```
